{{Top|leg}}
'''Bartyn's Landing town council''' was supposedly a democratically-elected body for the town of [[Bartyn's Landing]] in [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]]. However, from the founding of the town to c. [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], it held little power and was chosen through corrupt means.

==Organization and Powers==
The town council was formed by one [[Mayor/Legends|mayor]] and fourteen councilors representing the interests of the people. From the creation of [[Bartyn's Landing]] up until c. [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], the mayor was a member of the [[Bartyn family]], who also ruled the two more important local businesses&mdash;the fully automated mines for [[Outer Rim Oreworks Company|Outer Rim Oreworks]] and [[Bartyn Gourmet Delicacies]], giving a job to most of the people&mdash;and who held the property of almost all the land; sometimes, the Bartyns selected an agent or proxy as the mayor.<ref name="BL">{{GamerCite|7|Bartyn's Landing (article)}}</ref>

The councilors were publicly elected by the people in a vote that included a good amount of corruption. Even then, they had limited power, as they could not interfere in the management of ORO or in interplanetary trade, and the mayor could veto any action of the council, following the town charter&mdash;although this last action had only happened in the worst of times. The councilors did supervise the planetary trade of textiles and food with other towns in Lamaredd, including the sovereign state of [[Little Mon Cal]].<ref name="BL" />

The councilors voted who would be the [[Security Chief (ORO)|Security Chief]], or de facto constable of the town, even if the Chief was supposedly an employee of ORO. This vote was also prone to fraud.<ref name="BL" /> They also assigned budget to several official bodies, including the docks.<ref name="R">{{GamerCite|7|Reckonings}}</ref>

==History==
In [[69 BBY/Legends|69 BBY]], the town council unanimously elected [[Mix Liddell]] as the new Chief of Security.<ref name="BL" /> Forty years later, a well-liked councilor was murdered in a slum area of [[The Ring (district)|The Ring]] District, and Liddell investigated the case. He discovered that the councilor was a regular of the zone, where he resorted to [[Spice/Legends|spice]] and other unapproved entertainment.<ref name="BL" />

Soon after this event, ORO retired from Lamaredd and the Bartyn family lost much of its power. Eventually, the town council seized Bartyn Gourmet Delicacies, although the [[Sailor's Union]] would attempt to take over the company.<ref name="R" />
